bullets.text: Ransomware Alert: Storm-1175 Strikes - **Storm-1175** targets vulnerable web-facing systems, rapidly deploying **Medusa ransomware** post-exploitation.
SOHO Device Risk: DNS Hijacking - **Forest Blizzard** compromises **SOHO routers** for DNS hijacking, impacting numerous organizations.
AI Phishing Surge: Device Code Abuse - A new **phishing campaign** exploits Device Code Authentication, leveraging AI for greater success.
Windows 11 Insider Preview: New Builds - Recent **Windows 11 Insider** builds introduce improvements across various channels.
AI in Cybersecurity: A Double-Edged Sword - Threat actors are embedding **AI** into cyberattacks, enhancing precision and scale.
Supply Chain Threat: Axios npm Compromise - Malicious **Axios** npm packages linked to **Sapphire Sleet** deploy remote access trojans.
